t: This is the statue of Sir Henry Bartle Frere, installed in Whitehall Gardens in 1888. It's Grade II listed and the work of Thomas Brock, who also created the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace. Frere was a British colonial administrator who had a successful career in India and became Governor of Bombay. Later, as High Commissioner for Southern Africa, his policies led to a string of regional wars, and he was recalled to London and officially censured for acting recklessly.
